<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl (the O–H bond) in the forward reaction, which corresponds to protecting an alcohol with TMSOTf. Use the protected alcohol SMILES as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
